name: Tweaks & Settings
description: A shared settings hub. Adds one OPTIONS panel that controls the on-screen popups every mod uses (off / text-only / full bar, plus color, size, bold, duration, and a sound toggle) a one-tap RESET GRAPHICS that turns every visual effect off, and a BATTLE DIFF setting (Normal/Hard/Brutal) that the challenge mods read to make their teams tougher. Other mods use it when present and fall back to their own defaults when it is not.
